summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_047 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, emits a single bounded executive thesis, preserves contradiction-selection logic, handles inadmissible cases explicitly, and bridges congruence-specific takes without overrunning the structural evidence posture.

findings: The implementation accepts the documented structural, scenario, TAD and congruence inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before runtime delegation.

Executable coverage confirms the main bounded-thesis behaviors: one dominant contradiction, preserved ranked and rejected conflict candidates, bounded client-facing action count, and explicit inadmissible-thesis output when the case has not crossed the structural threshold.

Congruence-bridge coverage confirms that misunderstanding, boundary, comparison, loss, measurement, regulatory, finance and maintenance takes can enrich the thesis when admissible, and collapse back to empty values when inadmissible.
The thesis remains within boundary: it does not promote blocked financial logic into ROI certainty or force a stronger report mode than the one selected upstream.
The wrapper returns the expected top-level surfaces: executive_thesis, dominant_contradiction, supporting_mode_count and client_facing_action_count.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check over the One Vanderbilt bridge fixture produced thesis_state=admissible_structural_thesis, report_mode=Compliance / Investment Screening Brief, dominant_contradiction=Regulation vs control boundary, supporting_mode_count=1 and client_facing_action_count=1.
The same smoke preserved bounded interpretive signal types including boundary_misalignment, false_capex_logic and non_transferable_peer_advantage, and kept congruence_action_priority_count at 2.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered structural-thesis hierarchy, contradiction ranking, inadmissible thesis bypass, congruence-bridge enrichment, fallback action sourcing from congruence priority and non-building invalid-comparison cases. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises both the admissible and inadmissible thesis paths as well as the main bounded-interpretation safeguards.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_executive_thesis_report_hierarchy.py and runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_executive_thesis_congruence_bridge.py with 13 passing tests and 1 environment warning from urllib3/LibreSSL. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the One Vanderbilt bridge fixture and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface unchanged.
